in_sanskrit.name: सोमनन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is pleasing to the moon. Derived from the words 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Nandana' meaning pleasing or delighting.

in_hindi.name: सोमनन्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is dear to the moon (Soma). This name is derived from the words 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Nandana' meaning delighting or pleasing.

in_tamil.name: சோமநந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is the guardian of the auspicious hours of the day. Derived from the Tamil words 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Nandu' meaning guardian or protector.

in_telugu.name: శోమనన్ద
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the beloved of Lord Shiva. This name is derived from the words 'Soma' meaning moon and 'Nandana' meaning pleasure or delight.

in_marathi.name: Somananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Somananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Soma means 'calmness, peace' and Nanda means 'delight, pleasure'. The name Somananda thus means 'one who delights in peace, calmness'.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Peaceful, calming
